nodes.label: project 20 -- The nominal: 64,136 church bells in Dove's Guide, the note each is named by and the sound measured from it

inside a ring bells sit a median 4.5 cents from their own tenor; the ring sits a median 22 cents from its named note, 45 % of 6,549 rings beyond 25 cents (uniform would give 25 and 50 %); 1,919 of 2,185 ring bells named by a note not their nearest are so because the whole ring stands past the midpoint

intensity.value: a ring is in tune with itself, not with the note it is called
